prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity 16:10 desktop landing-page first viewport decision comp
Primary request: Design the Orifude landing page in a committed "Woodland broadside" direction. It must feel like a contemporary independent relief-print literary broadside, not a generic SaaS hero. Make the oversized editorial headline the dominant object, occupying most of the viewport: "A letter for one stranger." Render that headline verbatim and highly legibly in a characterful literary old-style serif, with dramatic scale and tight but elegant line spacing.
Input images: Image 1 is the supplied Orifude wordmark. Use this exact identity once in the upper left, clean and undistorted. Image 2 is the supplied squirrel courier artwork. Use this courier once, intact, as a meaningful delivery image integrated near a strong woodland branch in the lower right quadrant. Do not redraw, duplicate, or alter its identity.
Scene/backdrop: warm washi paper field with restrained natural fiber and imperfect ink pickup, color #fbf7f1. Sparse relief-printed woodland branch and leaf forms create a strong asymmetrical composition without crossing readable copy.
Structure: 16:10 desktop website viewport. Quiet header with wordmark at upper left and three readable editorial navigation links at upper right: "How it works", "Privacy", "Download". Huge headline across the left and center. Beneath it, one short factual sentence: "A keyboard-only terminal post office for one private letter and one optional reply." On the lower right, one large, wide dark-moss download field with irregular relief-print edges, not rounded, containing the exact primary action "Download v0.2.0" and the supporting line "Linux · macOS · Windows". Include one restrained text link "View source" nearby. A small but readable clay status note may say "Private alpha".
Style/medium: shippable high-end web design mockup; contemporary independent letterpress and relief-print broadside; beautiful editorial typography; broad flat ink shapes; uneven ink density only at large decorative edges; crisp UI copy; strong negative space; no nostalgia costume, no Japanese pastiche.
Color palette: washi #fbf7f1, ink #292823, deep moss #626851, clay #a48b68. Use only these colors plus natural tones already present in the supplied art. Ink dominates type, moss is the singular action field, clay is a scarce accent.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:10, edge-to-edge first viewport, deliberately asymmetric and editorial. Headline should occupy around half the canvas area. The download field must be large and unmistakable, approximately one quarter of the viewport width or larger. Keep all text horizontal and readable.
Text (verbatim): "A letter for one stranger."; "A keyboard-only terminal post office for one private letter and one optional reply."; "Download v0.2.0"; "Linux · macOS · Windows"; "How it works"; "Privacy"; "Download"; "View source"; "Private alpha".
Constraints: real product facts only; Orifude website explains the project and distributes releases, never acts as a participant client; preserve the supplied wordmark and squirrel courier; one wordmark, one squirrel courier, one primary download field.
Avoid: thin-line borders anywhere; outlined boxes; glows; gradients; glass; rounded cards; pill buttons; generic dashboard or startup SaaS layout; excessive monospace; tiny labels; uppercase tech-eyebrows; section numbers; fake metrics; testimonials; customer logos; invented claims; extra mascots; origami crane clichés; decorative Japanese motifs; unreadable or garbled text; watermarks.
editPrompt:

Asset type: full-fidelity 16:10 desktop landing-page first viewport decision comp base for exact artwork compositing
Primary request: Remove only the squirrel, its tail, and the paper letter it holds from the lower-right woodland branch. Reconstruct the washi background and the branch naturally behind the removed animal, leaving generous clean space above the branch for an exact supplied cutout to be composited later.
Invariants: Keep every other pixel-level design decision unchanged: exact layout, dimensions and crop; exact headline "A letter for one stranger."; all other wording and characters; typography; positions; wordmark; navigation; leaf arrangements; washi texture; palette; dark moss download field; clay private-alpha note; view-source link. Preserve the 16:10 landscape aspect. Do not add any new object.
Avoid: changing text; garbled text; changing the branch except where reconstruction behind the removed squirrel requires it; adding another animal, envelope, logo, card, border, glow, gradient, or decorative motif.
generator: built-in image_gen with ImageMagick exact-asset composite
postProcess: Resize the edited base to 1600x1000, resize src/assets/orifude-courier-cutout.webp proportionally to 320px wide, composite the supplied transparent cutout at x=960 y=205, then encode WebP at quality 94.
